answer: A claim must be anchored to a dune of settled grains, each grain one prior interaction witnessed by an unrelated party. The epoch beacon reshapes dunes, so grains that drift together merge into one island and that island holds a single anchor. Copper is burned per anchor, and the k-th anchor an operator drives into the same dune costs k copper, so n aliases pay about n squared while sharing one standing. Grains cannot be traded, and moving one voids its witness record, so a coalition can buy neither depth nor a second vote.
